title: Depth-Dependent Safety Geometry in Vision-Language Models: Layer-Wise Localization and Bidirectional Refusal Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.32182v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are widely deployed, yet the internal mechanisms behind their safety behavior remain poorly understood. We present a lightweight inference-time framework for localizing and manipulating safety-sensitive representations in frozen VLMs, without retraining or modifying parameters. On Qwen3-VL-4B, layer-wise activation divergence analysis reveals non-uniform safety geometry across depth. Causal interventions show that early vision layers support strong bidirectional refusal control through activation steering along a learned safety direction, with unsafe rejection spanning 6%-96%, whereas later layers respond more to activation magnitude scaling and exhibit a substantial safety-selectivity trade-off. Deeper layers remain well separated along the safety direction yet are largely insensitive to steering, distinguishing representational separability from causal controllability. translated_title: 视觉语言模型中深度依赖的安全几何结构：逐层定位与双向拒答控制
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）已被广泛部署，但其安全行为背后的内部机制仍知之甚少。我们提出了一个轻量级的推理时框架，用于在冻结的视觉语言模型中定位并操控安全敏感表征，无需重新训练或修改参数。在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上，逐层激活差异分析揭示了安全几何结构在模型深度上呈非均匀分布。因果干预实验表明，早期视觉层通过沿学习到的安全方向进行激活引导，可实现强大的双向拒答控制，不安全拒绝率可在 6%–96% 之间调节；而后面的层对激活幅值缩放更为敏感，并表现出显著的安全性与选择性之间的权衡。更深的层沿安全方向保持良好的表征分离，但对激活引导基本不敏感，这区分了表征可分性与因果可控性。InternVL2.5-4B 在定性上（呈现出类似结果，摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一个无需重训的推理时框架，通过逐层激活分析揭示视觉语言模型的安全几何随深度非均匀分布——早期视觉层可通过激活引导实现 6%–96% 的双向拒答控制，而深层虽表征可分却对操控不敏感，从而区分了表征可分性与因果可控性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a lightweight inference-time framework showing that safety geometry in vision-language models is depth-dependent—early vision layers enable strong bidirectional refusal control via activation steering (6%–96% unsafe rejection), while deeper layers remain representationally separable yet causally insensitive to steering, distinguishing representational separability from causal controllability.
